claims.quote: The blotched snakehead, Channa maculata, is a snakehead from coastal drainages of southeastern China, including Hong Kong, and northern Vietnam.

regions.name: Yangtze
regions.quote: This species is widely-distributed in Pacific coastal drainages of southeastern China (e.g. the Yangtze, Minjiang, Hangjiang River, and Pearl (Nanjiujiang) rivers), including Hainan island and Hong Kong, and is also native to Vietnam (northern provinces to Quang Binh province).
